- start 2026-06-02T03:17:42, end 2026-06-02T03:53:31
- minutes_down 35.82 (exactly 2149 s = 35 m 49 s; rounded to 2 decimals)

Assumptions: minutes_down rounded to 2 decimals; availability = (43200 − 35.8167)/43200; timestamps are local log time, no timezone given.

[next] Nothing open; no browser/app was opened.
